thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 5995012345 created — kvcache memory surge on hosted-runtime, auto-pager triggered. Severity: P1. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/kvcache-oom

maria (oncall): I'm on it. Seeing OOM on hosted-prod-7, kvcache at 98%. A subset of /v1/generate requests returning 503. Long prompts in recent traffic.

sam: Looking at logs — got a config change in early morning: continuous-batching.batch_max_items bumped from 64 -> 256 for throughput tests. Could be related.

taylor: That was my change. I pushed the batching tweak at 09:46 UTC to improve throughput for small-ish requests. Rolling back now if that's the culprit.

maria (oncall): Do it. Immediate mitigation: rollback batch_max_items and throttle prefetch. I'll coordinate canary.

devon: I have a quick-prevent patch to set prefetch_depth=2 and tighter eviction threshold. Ready to apply to canary.

ops-bot: deploy triggered by taylor: deploy/config-revert-5995012345 -> canary(us-west-2) -> started.

sam: KV map growth pattern: continuous-batching seems to merge requests with unique per-request prefixes, generating many KV keys rather than reusing cache entries — amplified by long chat histories.

leah: Customer impact summary: two enterprise tenants in EU experienced elevated latency and intermittent 503s between 10:12-10:22 UTC. CS notified, opening customer pings.

maria (oncall): Live grafana: https://grafana.redwood/graphs/kvcache/memory?from=5995012200&to=5995012500 — clear spike aligned with batch change.

incident-bot: Pager notified @maria @taylor @sam @devon.

taylor: Rollback completed on canary at 5995012360. Observing metrics.

maria (oncall): Canary looks stable, kvcache memory trending down from 98% -> 60% in 3m. Starting staged rollback to remaining hosts.

devon: Prefetch change applied on canary: `prefetch_depth=2`. Also set `kvcache_evict_threshold=0.75` to trigger evictions earlier.

sam: Long-term: we need prefix dedupe across batched requests and a window boundary so continuous-batching doesn't create cross-session key multiplicity. I'll draft a repro.

leah: Drafting customer comms now — short note + ETA for postmortem. Will include affected tenants, time window, and mitigation summary.

maria (oncall): Ops note from taylor (rollback commands):
```
kubectl set env deployment/hosted-runtime BATCH_MAX_ITEMS=64 --namespace=prod
kubectl rollout restart deployment/hosted-runtime
```

ops-bot: Canary -> rollout to remaining 8 hosts initiated by taylor at 5995012410.

taylor: Hotfix PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8423 — changes: clamp `batch_max_items`, add prefetch depth guard, and KV prefix dedupe.

sam: Running load replay on staging to validate. Preliminary looks clean. No memory regression observed with long prompt replay.

devon: Added temporary alert: `kvcache_memory_pct > 85% for 2m` -> page oncall. Also capturing heap traces on hosts that hit >90%.

maria (oncall): Thanks team. Action items: postmortem owner = sam, customer comms = leah, long-term runtime fix = taylor/devon. Handoff planned for 11:00 UTC.

taylor: @maria handing off to @devon for overnight watch.

maria (oncall): Handoff accepted, will post notes to incident timeline.

devon: Taking over. I'll keep an eye on kvcache cardinality and heap traces, will escalate if we see growth >10% in 15m.

leah: Customer pings sent at 10:40 UTC; tenant-A and tenant-B acknowledged — degraded sessions only, no data loss reported.

sam: Root cause summary for postmortem: batching config change increased batch item cap which allowed cross-request batching to expand internal KV key space for long-prefix sessions, causing kvcache cardinality explosion -> OOM. Repro and test plan in PR.

maria (oncall): Incident marked mitigated at 5995012460. :white_check_mark: Will keep channel for follow-ups until postmortem.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 5995012345 marked mitigated by maria (oncall). Timeline and logs: https://incident.redwood/5995012345

(reacts: taylor :thumbsup:, sam :raised_hands:)
